Synopsis:
    U.S. Ambassador Mike Huckabee visited Turmus Ayya in the occupied West Bank, meeting Palestinian Americans including relatives of U.S. citizens killed by Israeli settlers. He acknowledged settler violence as terrorism but framed it as the work of a small minority, while stopping short of pressuring Netanyahu's government. Local Palestinian American officials pushed back, arguing U.S. leverage is being underutilized. The visit reflects growing international pressure over settler violence and Israeli government inaction, with at least six Palestinian Americans killed since 2024.
